description: This file contains utility functions and encoder configurations for serializing various Python objects, particularly in the context of FastAPI and Pydantic models. It includes functions like isoformat, decimal_encoder, and jsonable_encoder, as well as custom encoder mappings for serializing types such as datetime, Decimal, Enum, UUID, and Pydantic models.

methods.name: str isoformat(o: Union[datetime.date, datetime.time])
methods.description: Formats a date or time object to ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: Union[int,float] decimal_encoder(dec_value: Decimal)
methods.description: Encodes a Decimal as int if no exponent is present, otherwise as float.

methods.name: dict[Callable[[Any],Any],tuple[Any,...]] generate_encoders_by_class_tuples( type_encoder_map: dict[Any, Callable[[Any], Any]], )
methods.description: Creates a mapping from encoder functions to tuples of classes they handle.

methods.description: Converts arbitrary Python objects into JSON-serializable forms, supporting a variety of types and custom encoders.
